subject.title: fix: ClawHub search passes unbounded limit to the API

question: Should `openclaw skills search` intentionally gain a public maximum of 100 even though the current CLI accepts larger values and ClawHub returns more than 100 results?
rationale: A universal maximum is a user-visible CLI policy choice, not an established bug contract, and cannot safely be inferred from the Gateway’s separately validated limit.

options.title: Preserve the current CLI contract
options.body: Remove the shared 100 clamp and retain caller-owned limits, leaving the existing Gateway maximum in its schema.

options.title: Adopt an explicit CLI maximum
options.body: Define the maximum at the CLI boundary with a clear validation error, docs, and live compatibility proof rather than silently truncating in shared infra.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current CLI contract
recommendation.body: Remove the shared 100 clamp and retain caller-owned limits, leaving the existing Gateway maximum in its schema.

likelyOwner.reason: The native ClawHub search flow and its central CLI/infra contract appear to originate from and remain concentrated in steipete's history.
